Attached: 2 images

Stocky can now keep track of Filter settings on a per-Workspace level, allowing different selection criteria to be applied to different groupings.

This granularity is going to be very useful, as the previous implementation was a little limiting.   For example your Price/Earnings (PE) filtering criteria would be dramatically different when viewing a Workspace of Growth stocks vs. a Workspace of Dividend stocks.  This update makes it possible to have unique filter settings to compensate.

Stocky is a MacOS native application for fetching and analysis of stock market data, guiding sound investment decisions.

More information at https://red82.com/stocky/
